brief:
Qatar's Prime Minister has denounced what he characterized as atrocities in Gaza, telling Piers Morgan that nothing justifies the violence, Al Jazeera English reported. The Qatari leader reaffirmed Doha's commitment to pursuing diplomatic channels and mediating peace efforts across the Middle East despite the escalating humanitarian crisis.

Qatar has positioned itself as a neutral broker in Middle East conflicts, maintaining diplomatic engagement even as violence in Gaza intensifies.
dek: Qatar's top diplomat says Israel has undermined Doha's efforts to broker a ceasefire in Gaza from 'day one'.
title: Qatar's PM condemns Gaza atrocities, vows continued mediation efforts
